Players Committee card image of [[Savage Opress (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “Deploys -1 for each other Sith character on table (limit - 4). Once per game, may exchange a card in hand with a Sith character in Lost Pile. Immune to attrition < 3.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Dark/large/savageopress.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3f7288d580f892a638c6e3b78ca43474ade7756a 3f7288d] (21 April 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
